title: Winmark Corporation Announces Quarterly Cash Dividend
summary: MINNEAPOLIS, July 15, 2026--Winmark Corporation (Nasdaq: WINA) announced today that its Board of Directors has approved the payment of a quarterly cash dividend to shareholders. The quarterly dividend of $1.02 per share will be paid on September 1, 2026 to shareholders of record on the close of business on August 12, 2026. Future dividends will be subject to Board approval.
